SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN ws."extTempC" < -40 THEN 'Extreme Cold'
        WHEN ws."extTempC" >= -40 AND ws."extTempC" < -20 THEN 'Standard Cold'
        ELSE 'Mild Cold'
    END as temp_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pb."PWR_BATT_ID") as num_equipment,
    AVG((pb.battery_telemetry->'battery_pack'->>'health_pct')::numeric) as avg_battery_health
FROM "PowerBattery" pb
JOIN "Equipment" e ON pb.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" tws ON tws.batt_link = pb."PWR_BATT_ID"
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = tws.comm_link
JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws."loc_link" = c.loc_link
GROUP BY temp_zone
ORDER BY temp_zone;

WITH station_temp AS (
    SELECT loc_link, AVG("extTempC") as avg_extTempC
    FROM "WeatherAndStructure"
    GROUP BY loc_link
),
station_zone AS (
    SELECT loc_link,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_extTempC < -40 THEN 'Extreme Cold'
            WHEN avg_extTempC >= -40 AND avg_extTempC < -20 THEN 'Standard Cold'
            ELSE 'Mild Cold'
        END as temp_zone
    FROM station_temp
)
SELECT 
    sz.temp_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pb."PWR_BATT_ID") as num_equipment,
    ROUND(AVG((pb.battery_telemetry->'battery_pack'->>'health_pct')::numeric), 2) as avg_battery_health
FROM "PowerBattery" pb
JOIN "Equipment" e ON pb.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" tws ON tws.batt_link = pb."PWR_BATT_ID"
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = tws.comm_link
JOIN "station_zone" sz ON sz.loc_link = c.loc_link
GROUP BY sz.temp_zone
ORDER BY sz.temp_zone;

    CASE 
        WHEN ws."extTempC" < -40 THEN 'Extreme Cold'
        WHEN ws."extTempC" >= -40 AND ws."extTempC" < -20 THEN 'Standard Cold'
        ELSE 'Mild Cold'
    END as temperature_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pb."PWR_BATT_ID") as num_equipment,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(pb.battery_telemetry->'battery_pack'->>'health_pct' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_battery_health
FROM "PowerBattery" pb
JOIN "Equipment" e ON pb.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws."loc_link" = c.loc_link
GROUP BY temperature_zone
ORDER BY temperature_zone;

        WHEN ws."extTempC" < -40 THEN 'Extreme Cold'
        WHEN ws."extTempC" >= -40 AND ws."extTempC" < -20 THEN 'Standard Cold'
        ELSE 'Mild Cold'
    END as temperature_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pb."PWR_BATT_ID") as num_equipment,
    AVG(CAST(pb.battery_telemetry->'battery_pack'->>'health_pct' AS numeric)) as avg_battery_health
FROM "PowerBattery" pb
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = pb.equip_ref
JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws."loc_link" = c.loc_link
GROUP BY temperature_zone
ORDER BY temperature_zone;
